purpose: Post-hoc secondary diagnostic after fixed-frequency-anchor native, public, and NR comparisons. Quantify how much of their complex residual is removable by one global time and phase shift. This is an unweighted time-domain statistic, not the paper's detector-noise-weighted faithfulness or a release holdout.
phase: One constant complex rotation chosen analytically after the time shift; no amplitude or intrinsic-parameter optimization.
